rows.rule: Four 600-second periods, two rosters of 22 and 12 active
First Hunt opens every regulation and overtime period; any field contestant
False start retaken
First tied overtime 300 s, runs whole period
Later sudden death ends on any score, full and half forced
No kick releases or strike path
One throw-and-replay dribble; second offence minor; stoppage and other touch reset
30 s fresh after score and turnover; carries tackle
Play expiry turnover spot or own 40 nearer attacked goal
Snap clock runs only when more than ten remained
Game clock stops every dead ball
100x100 surface and strict 20 m configured zone arc
3 m goal semicircle and 3 m quadrant depth
Whole ball crosses inside goal section
Platform fixed 5 m high / 5 m back, one per goal
Platform arrow ballistic reach tested
Flat two-point goal and one-point half goal
Carry tracked separately
Noncarry release distance and success counters
Keeper cannot score for own team, own goal for opponents
First tackle contact scrimmage inside zone; attacked goal x<10 resets to 10
Tackled snapper and tackler recorded
Missed ten-second snap window count+1 and 5 m back
Offence offside count+1 and 5 m back; second turnover
Defence offside count-1 floor zero, 5 m forward; no half goal
Second tackle turnover spot or own40 nearer attacked goal
Offence minor count+1, second turnover
Defence minor decrements; count zero awards half P1-3 / full P4+ and retains
Unintentional head minor; intent-chosen head/trip major
First major 120 s game-time exclusion, second DQ
Fourth minor 60 s exclusion, fifth DQ
Cover exclusions/DQ and eligible return after time
Forfeit only below 12 currently available of 22
Off-ball legal band, hip push/stab; no pulling/gripping
Carrier wrap and knee/joint legal below neck
Keeper inside own zone protected from opponent initiation when PP own
Keeper never Archer target; inside-zone Keeper never freezes
ZR-1/C/T enforced as opponent RST-1 with clock reset
25 arrows, illegal release spends ammo and minor, abort no spend
At most five freezes, freeze5 plus immunity10
Recovery protection3m/2s
Targets opposing fields on offence with control, outside both zones
Shot release at expiry counts, only shots retain flight
Goal wins coincident catch; boundary wins secure hold
Toss crossing point, goal-line zone slide, thrower outside, 3 m clearance, ready1.5
Toss within4s of ready
Toss cannot score direct; taker cannot recover
No hidden attributes in pure decide, commands retain intent IDs
Formation-free parameter vector / residence compliance intent
Environment cannot turn on legacy layers or mix Native config
Serialized view+belief replays decision
M2 null present equals absent; paired harness
